Noor Khan: hi everyone! I'm Noor, starting today as a Backend Infra Eng. based in IST. excited to join :tada: Quick Q — where should I start for laptop enrolment and repo access?
Alexandra Lee: welcome Noor! :wave: We'll get you set. Mira will be your onboarding buddy. Please ping #eng-oncall if anything urgent.
Mira Patel: hey Noor — super excited. I sent you a calendar invite for a 1:1 in 30m. For laptop, follow IT bot steps below and DM me for keys.
IT Onboarding Bot: Welcome Noor! To enroll laptop, run:
```
mkdir -p ~/.ssh && ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "noor@redwood.com"
echo "Paste pub key in Okta > Devices"
```
Also submit a ticket at https://redwood.atlassian.net/servicedesk and choose "New Hire Laptop" :laptop:
Noor Khan: thanks — will do. Is VPN needed for initial setup, or just Okta device?
Emma Chen: Okta + MDM should be enough for dev machines. VPN needed for some internal APIs later — Jon can add you to prod-readonly if you need it.
Jon Brooks: added Noor to github org (read). If you need additional repos, DM me the list. For prod access we follow the ramp plan — ping me when you want staging creds.
Noor Khan: awesome, thx all. small fun fact — I'm a weekend beekeeper 🐝. looking forward to pair on infra tests!
Alexandra Lee: love the beekeeper detail :heart_eyes: Welcome aboard, Noor. We'll run through the first-week checklist in our 1:1.
Mira Patel: FYI quick resources: onboarding guide https://redwood.dev/onboard, dev setup script: `curl -fsSL https://get.redwood.dev/setup.sh | bash` — run after laptop is enrolled.
Noor Khan: noted. I'll start the steps and report back here if I hit blockers. :)
